terms.title: Public offer
terms.intro: This document is a public offer — a proposal to enter into a contract for the sale of digital goods on the terms below. Placing an order means you accept them in full.

sections.p: YTT OMONOV JAMSHID IBROHIM OʻGʻLI (trading as YuPay), Tax ID 50304056560048. Full details and contact channels are on the Legal details page.

Digital goods: in-game currency, game wallet top-ups, subscriptions and activation codes. Goods are supplied without a physical medium — credited to the game ID you provide, or issued as a code. We resell these goods and are not their publisher.

The contract is concluded when the order is paid. Before payment you see the final amount in som and what the order contains; pressing the pay button is acceptance of this offer. You may withdraw acceptance any time before payment simply by not completing it. An unpaid order is cancelled automatically once its payment window elapses.

Prices are in Uzbek som and include all taxes. The rate is fixed when the order is placed and the final amount is shown before payment. We charge no separate fee on top — our margin is already in the price. Payment by Uzcard and Humo through Click, Payme or Uzum. A fiscal receipt is issued after payment.

We control and limit fraud risk in line with the law of the Republic of Uzbekistan and our partner banks' requirements: we screen payments for signs of fraud, restrict transactions flagged by the bank's security systems, identify and verify the payer, and use secure data channels and up-to-date information-security tools. If we detect a risk, we may temporarily suspend a transaction, request additional confirmation of identity or of the payment method, or decline it — and where needed we work with the bank to prevent unauthorised charges. In turn, you agree not to share your personal data, passwords or confirmation codes with third parties, to report suspicious transactions to us immediately, and to follow the general rules for safe use of electronic payment systems.

Most orders are fulfilled automatically within 1–5 minutes of payment confirmation. You are responsible for the accuracy of the game ID and other account details: goods credited to details you entered incorrectly count as properly delivered and are not refundable. If fulfilment is delayed, the order status is available from the link in your email and under My orders.

If an order has not been and cannot be fulfilled, we return the amount paid within 5 (five) business days of the refund being agreed. Refunds are made by the same method the payment was made. We bear the costs of the refund. See the Refunds page for detail.

We may change this offer. A new version takes effect when published on this page; the date of the last update is shown at the top. Orders already placed are governed by the version in force when they were paid. Changing the terms of a specific order after payment requires agreement between both parties.

We are not responsible for the acts of game platforms and publishers, including account bans and restrictions, nor for the consequences of you giving third parties access to your account. We never ask for your game account password.
Disputes are settled by negotiation first — write to support@yupay.uz. Failing agreement, a dispute is resolved in accordance with the law of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

agreement.title: Terms of use
agreement.intro: These terms govern your use of the YuPay service: the website, the Telegram app and the bot. The terms of purchase are set out separately, in the public offer. By using the service you accept these terms.

sections.p: The service is for people aged 18 or over with the legal capacity to enter into contracts. If you are under 18, use the service only with the consent of a parent or other legal representative and with their means of payment. One person uses one account.

You are responsible for keeping access to your account safe and for what is done under it. By entering a game ID or other details you confirm you are entitled to use them. We never ask for your game account password — a request in our name is fraud; tell us about it.

Paying for orders with someone else's or stolen means of payment. Giving knowingly false information about yourself. Using the service to launder proceeds of crime or for any other unlawful purpose. Circumventing limits and restrictions, including by creating multiple accounts. Using automated tools to place orders or harvest site data. Reselling goods received in breach of the rights holders' rules.

Where a transaction raises reasonable doubt, we may pause it and ask you to confirm the payer's identity or the right to use the payment instrument. This is required by our agreements with the payment organisations and is an anti-fraud measure. Until you reply the order stays unfulfilled; if confirmation is not provided, we refund by the method the payment was made.

We may restrict or end access to the service for breach of these terms, on reasonable indications of fraud or use of someone else's payment instrument, where requested confirmations are not provided, and at the demand of an authorised state body. We tell you about a block and its reason using the contacts you gave us. A block does not affect orders already paid and fulfilled: access to goods you received is kept. If you believe a block is wrong, write to support@yupay.uz and we will look at it.

We may decline to fulfil a particular order — including where the item is unavailable from the supplier, where there has been a technical or pricing error, and in the cases above. On refusal the amount paid is refunded in full, in the manner and within the time stated in the offer.

If something is wrong with an order, write to us first — almost everything is settled within one business day. Raising a dispute with your bank without contacting support removes our ability to look into it and may lead to access being restricted. This does not limit your rights as a consumer or prevent you approaching your card issuer.

The service is provided as is. We are not responsible for the acts of game platforms and publishers, including account bans and changes to game rules, nor for interruptions caused by matters outside our control. Our liability for a given order is limited to its amount. This clause does not limit liability that the law does not allow to be limited.

We are not liable for failures caused by circumstances beyond reasonable control: outages at payment systems and suppliers, restrictions imposed by state bodies, failures of communications and power, and other extraordinary events.

The text, design, code and other elements of the site and apps belong to us. Game and platform trademarks belong to their owners and are used solely to identify what a product works with. Copying service content for commercial use without our consent is not permitted.

We may change these terms. A new version takes effect when published on this page; the date of the last update is shown at the top. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept the new version. Orders already paid are governed by the terms in force when they were paid.

These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Disputes are settled by negotiation and, failing agreement, in the manner established by the law of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Where language versions differ, the Russian version prevails.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect the minimum data needed to fulfil your order and never sell it to third parties.

sections.p: Email (for the receipt and order status), the game ID or account identifier, and payment data. Card details are handled by the payment provider — we do not store them. When you place an order we also record technical details of the request: IP address, browser information, timezone, language and screen size.
Only to fulfil the order, provide support and send the receipt. We do not share data for advertising.

The IP address and browser details are stored alongside the order so we can confirm it was genuine if the cardholder disputes the payment. Our payment providers require this: without such records a dispute is decided against us automatically. The data is visible to administrators only, is never used for advertising, and is deleted automatically 600 days after the order.
Data is shared with suppliers and payment services only to the extent needed to fulfil the order.
You can request deletion of your data by contacting support.
The site uses technical cookies for the interface and basic analytics.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.intro: When we refund, how long it takes, and what you need to do.

sections.p: When an order has not been and cannot be fulfilled — for example, the item is unavailable from the supplier. The amount is refunded in full.

Once the goods have been credited: a digital good has been delivered and cannot be taken back. Also where the game ID or account details were entered incorrectly by you — the goods have already been delivered to the details you gave.

We decide on a request within one business day. The refund is made within 5 (five) business days of being agreed, by the same method the payment was made. We bear the costs. Your bank may need additional time to post it to the card.
Write to support@yupay.uz or Telegram @yupay_support with your order number. Email fixes the date the clock starts from.
